entities_found.entity_name: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

atoms.text: When the data generator supports data generator-calculated split cost allocation, column conforming to DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllocationHandling attribute MUST adhere to the following requirements:
section_path: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

atoms.text: [*FOCUS dataset column*](#glossary:FOCUS-dataset-column) values in *allocated charges* MUST match the corresponding value in the *origin charge* when the *FOCUS dataset column* represents a dimension.
section_path: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

atoms.text: *FOCUS dataset column* values in *allocated charges* MUST match the corresponding value in the *origin charge* when the *FOCUS dataset column* represents a non-summable [*metric*](#glossary:metric) (e.g., unit prices).
section_path: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

atoms.text: The sum of *FOCUS dataset column* values in *allocated charges* MUST match the corresponding value in the *origin charge* when the *FOCUS dataset column* represents a summable *metric* (e.g., costs and quantities).
section_path: Data Generator-Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling
